basic_info.description: Set on the sunny summit of coveted Potrero Hill, 986 Carolina Street commands breathtaking 180-degree panoramas that sweep from Twin Peaks to Mount Davidson and across to Bernal Heights.  The home is a masterful blend of early 20th-century charm and contemporary sophistication. This single-family residence, originally constructed in 1906, has been thoughtfully remodeled to cater to modern sensibilities while preserving its historic essence. The main living level is open concept living room with views of the Carolina Green Space, a formal dining room and cook's kitchen that leads out to a deck with sweeping views. This level also provides 2 large bedrooms, the primary w/ ensuite bath. Both upper baths have stone counters, one with a tub. The updated kitchen features granite counters and gas appliances, a breakfast bar and separate desk area. Downstairs also provides sweeping views, a sunny view deck, 1 bedroom, 1 bath and open space, perfect for guests, an au pair, or teenager.   Potrero Hill stands as one of San Francisco's most cherished historic districts, renowned for its microclimate of sunshine, village-like atmosphere, and architectural significance. Here, Victorian-era charm meets contemporary San Francisco living, w/ acclaimed restaurants, artisanal cafes, boutique shops.
